Move, Capture, GenericNotify and LowTime are Lichess's "standard" sound set from
https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/sound/standard.
lila's COPYING.md lists these sounds under "Exceptions (non-free)", so this repository does not ship them:
`scripts/fetch_sounds.sh` downloads them for local, personal use. Without them the app works silently.
